# Iterative Prompting: How to Refine AI Outputs with Follow-Up Questions
[#iterativeprompting](https://dev.to/t/iterativeprompting)[#aimarketingcopy](https://dev.to/t/aimarketingcopy)[#highconversionmarketing](https://dev.to/t/highconversionmarketing)[#promptengineering](https://dev.to/t/promptengineering)
You’ve probably felt the frustration: hitting 'generate' on your AI tool and getting something…*almost*right. It’s bland, off-brand, or just plain doesn't sing. In the fast-paced world of marketing, where every word, every headline, and every call-to-action directly impacts your conversion rates, "almost right" simply isn't good enough. Generic AI outputs don’t build trust, they don't capture attention, and they certainly don't drive sales.
So, how do you bridge the gap between basic AI output and high-converting marketing gold? The answer lies in mastering a powerful technique: iterative prompting.
